title: Existence of normalized open restriction data
statement: For an open immersion and restriction-identification datum, normalized geometric squares and open comparisons exist for every coefficient map.

proof.text: Use identity on extension-by-zero summands, sheafification and adjunction mates.

lean.statement: theorem systemOpenRestrictionData (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (c : RestrictionIdentifications.{u} l) : ∃ (g : ∀ (B C : Etale.SystemProjection.Coefficients.{u} l) (a : B.rings ⟶ C.rings), GeometricSquare a j) (o : ∀ (B C : Etale.SystemProjection.Coefficients.{u} l) (a : B.rings ⟶ C.rings), OpenComparison (g B C a)), True
